title: Butter Chicken
equipment: Dutch oven or heavy bottomed pan with lid
ingredients: 1 Lb chicken breast cut into cubes
1 Tbsp garlic paste, or 4-5 garlic cloves
instructions: Marinate the chicken with the ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, and salt. Let it sit for 20-30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a heavy bottomed pan or Dutch oven over medium heat, and saute the marinated chicken. Once cooked, place aside in a bowl.
In the same pan, add a little more oil, and att 2 Tbsp of salted butter and the onions.
Once the onions are cooked, about 3-4 minutes, add the tomatoes and cashews and saute stir until coated in oil.
Add the chili powder, garam masala, sugar, garlic, and 1 cup of water. Stir.
Mix everything and let it simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
After the 15 minutes are up, turn off the stove and use a hand blender or food processor, blend into a fine puree.
Turn the stove on again, and add the remaining butter, cream, cooked chicken, and kasuri methi.
Garnish (optional) with some more cream and kasuri methi and serve with roti or naan.
